domain: Help-desk knowledge graph: tickets, their work-log details, and the requesters who opened them, plus an optional knowledge layer (linked tickets, knowledge articles, and resolutions).

nodeLabels.TicketDetail: A work-log/comment entry on a ticket.
nodeLabels.Requester: An email address that opened tickets.
nodeLabels.Day: A calendar day a ticket was opened or a detail was logged.
nodeLabels.Resolution: A record of how a ticket was resolved (graph-only).
